stage: One post-v1 exploratory model revision on corrected development data; pre-result freeze; no claim of untouched development
hypothesis: Separately supervising a reported bid-location factor and its auction-clearing ratio on their origin-known scales lets random demand integration add value over the same factorization with free ratio probabilities.
horizon_unit: events in the complete calendar vintage known at issue time
fold_rule: For evaluation year Y: tune on examples with issue year Y-1 and target_date < Y-01-01; initial training targets < (Y-1)-01-01; then refit using all matured targets < Y-01-01 for the selected epoch count. Evaluate forecasts issued in Y; model weights remain fixed within Y. Histories update only as observed.
training_price_loss: MSE in a common origin-volatility and known-gap normalization
future_bid_role: label only; never input; missing/cancelled price is never replaced by zero
point_baseline_distribution: Per-horizon empirical quantiles of validation standardized residuals, centered to mean zero; 101 equal-weight atoms. No holdout temperature fitting. RW also reports a causal FHS sensitivity separately if run.
primary_estimator: Equal-weight ensemble of all three refit seeds, including a mixture of their price distributions. Classical forecasts have one deterministic fit.
primary_metric: Arithmetic mean of price MSE / same-origin RW MSE over 3 issue years x 3 horizons, equal cell weight
selection_metric: Same equal-horizon price MSE / RW MSE on the preceding validation year, no test-driven selection
secondary_metrics: CRPS relative to validation-calibrated RW distribution
uncertainty: Paired moving-block bootstrap on chronological issue dates, all horizons and platforms at a date kept together; 20-origin blocks, 2000 draws, fixed seed 20261018. Seeds do not count as independent market samples.

advancement_gates.MSE_vs_best_matched_predictor: at least 2 percent lower than best aggregate FactorDirect, GRU_full, MLP_full, Ridge or HistGB
advancement_gates.mean_demand_integration: at least 1 percent lower MSE than FDMC_plugin
advancement_gates.supply_operator: at least 1 percent lower MSE than FDMC_no_supply
advancement_gates.stability: MSE beats RW in at least 6 of 9 year-horizon cells and no year aggregate exceeds RW by over 10 percent
advancement_gates.uncertainty: 95 percent paired block-bootstrap upper bound for aggregate MSE ratio against best matched predictor is below 1
advancement_gates.scale_separation: strictly lower aggregate MSE than FDMC_unseparated; additional mechanistic requirement

confirmation: Only after every v2 development gate passes, including extra scale gate, and all data repair audits pass: separately freeze confirmation procedure. Failed original or corrected v1 gates are never retrospectively declared passed.
cancellation: Only 3 development cancellations, and secondary-market rejection is confidential. Gamma failure probabilities concern B<S only. No claim of calibrated actual cancellation forecasting or identified censoring. Global observed cancellation frequency is a diagnostic baseline.
novelty_boundary: Gamma measures, differentiable clearing, probability forecasts, auxiliary losses, positive residual parameterizations and as-of alignment are not individually new. The candidate contribution is the constrained, partially supervised random-demand clearing combination; it is falsified if matched direct or operator ablations absorb its gain.
implementation_repairs: Only documented numerical/data implementation repairs permitted after freeze, with retained failures and complete affected reruns. No architecture/loss/search changes using evaluation scores.
distribution: One conditional lognormal reported-median factor times a discrete Gamma-clearing price/median ratio; conditional independence is a working model; exact finite lognormal-mixture mean, CDF and CRPS.
auxiliary_labels: Future reported bid median, observed P/M ratio and total B are labels only, never inference inputs. Price forward always integrates predicted M; no teacher forcing.
micro_scale: Past 60 completed auctions: median |reported median-clearing|; floor max(0.01 EUR,0.0001*M0), without a horizon multiplier. location=4*tanh(raw/4), span=.25+3.75*sigmoid(raw-log(4)), fixed before fitting.
direct_comparator: FactorDirect has identical location distribution, bounded ratio grid, auxiliary labels/losses and parameter count. Its price weights and reference center are free probabilities, with no Gamma clearing or Gamma success weighting; its encoder may use all known context.
baseline_information: All v2 predictors have original histories/context plus origin-known log micro scale/P0 and log M0/P0. RW and LastBidMedian do not require the extra predictors.
numerical_base: Physical base ratios use float64 and are recomputed from identical origin/calendar quantities; original roundoff difference is reported. No changes to target, raw price, origin or forecast scale.
